nlbw.title: Traffic usage
nlbw.help: Traffic per device and protocol, counted by nlbwmon from the connection tracking table. Only traffic to or from the local networks below is counted.
nlbw.no_data: No traffic counted in this period yet.
nlbw.settings_help: Changes are staged and applied with rollback; the counter restarts with the new settings.
nlbw.interval_help: A day of the month (1 = the first, -1 = the last day), or a start date and a length in days, e.g. 2026-01-05/14.
nlbw.interval_invalid: Use a day of the month (-31 to 31) or YYYY-MM-DD/days.
nlbw.duration_help: A number with an optional unit: s, m, h or d.
nlbw.duration_invalid: Use a number with an optional unit: s, m, h or d.
nlbw.commit_help: How often the counters are written to the database directory.
nlbw.directory_help: /var/lib/nlbwmon is in RAM and lost on reboot; a directory on USB storage keeps the history. Avoid the internal flash: frequent writes wear it out.
